summary: 70-year-old man accidentally shot himself in the leg when a handgun in his pack discharged near Emerald Lake; carried out in a wheeled litter; airlifted to MCR.
location: Emerald Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Date corrected 2020-07-27 -> 2020-07-19 per RMNP press release (News Release Date July 28, 2020; incident 'Sunday afternoon, July 19'); morning-report log entry mis-dated July 27.
